title: Chapter 221
text:
These thirteen construction requirements were all basic construction, such as repelling beasts, clearing the ruins, water and electricity grid, housing, the number of residents, city walls, and so on. There were dozens of requirements for [Sanctuary Three], and this was only a part of them.

The blueprint construction was originally a three-month plan, and the goal was to complete the shelter's prototype within the specified time. Sanctuary One has been under construction for a month, and the progress is about half done. Using them as a reference, three months seems to be more than enough …

Han Xiao suddenly thought about it. No, Bennett has tens of thousands of workers, and I only have a thousand in the first month. If I do the mission the normal way, the time will be very tight.

Suddenly, there was a commotion in front of them, and the fleet quickly stopped. There were thousands of people gathered at the entrance of the abandoned city.

"Something's wrong!"

The guards quickly got out of the car and surrounded the group in the center. At this time, the crowd also noticed the fleet and moved toward them.

These people were wearing strange clothes, and the people of the Dark Net recognized them immediately.

Inhumans!

Nervousness exploded in their hearts. Facing the mysterious Inhumans, everyone felt scared. Inhumans were much more dangerous than beasts, and they could revive! Just Black Phantom's mechanical creation alone might not be able to protect everyone.

Huang Yu was shocked.

"So many Inhumans? Why are they gathered here? The organization sent people to the Graymetal Ruins to scout a while ago, and there was no one here! "

In Han Xiao's vision, the dense IDs above the players' heads made him dizzy. This time, he lifted the corner of his windbreaker and walked out of the car. He pushed through the crowd and stood at the front of the fleet with his hands behind his back.

Sandwiched between the two parties, his posture was like a javelin pointing straight at the sky. A light wind blew past, and his windbreaker fluttered like a black flag fluttering in the wind. Just his imposing appearance alone immediately attracted everyone's attention.

The people of the Dark Net were shocked. When the Inhumans saw Han Xiao, they actually stopped on their own.

"Black Phantom, we're here for the mission." This was honest.

"We heard you want to build a shelter, so we're here to help." This was immersive.

"After waiting for so long, I almost thought it was just a rumor." He heaved a sigh of relief.

Han Xiao clasped his hands behind his back and nodded pretentiously. "Thank you for your help. Everything is for the people. Our convoy is preparing to enter the city. Please make way. When we settle down, we will plan the construction goals of the city. At that time, there will be many job opportunities."

Hearing this, the players obediently made way.

The people of the Dark Net opened their mouths wide in shock.

These Inhumans were actually here to help Black Phantom. Since when did Black Phantom have such a huge influence among the Inhumans?

Huang Yu was stunned. Han Xiao had the confidence to complete the prototype within a month because he could command the mutants?

To Blue Star, Inhumans were a strange phenomenon. Everyone was very vigilant, and when they came into contact with Inhumans, their attitude was relatively cold. Therefore, when he saw this scene, Huang Yu only felt that it was inconceivable.

How did Black Phantom do it? Why would the Mutants respect him?

"I have to report this to Mr. Bennett …" Huang Yu thought.

With the addition of the players, the team instantly expanded by a few times and entered the Graymetal Ruins.

The convoy found a place to stop. Coney Fury hesitated and said, "Your Excellency, we need to clear an area to set up camp. It's not early now, so it's best to finish before dark. We don't have many people, so we have to start immediately."

"You go find those Inhumans for help."

"Me?" Coney Fury was a little scared.

"With me here, what are you afraid of?" Han Xiao patted him on the shoulder.

Coney Fury had nothing to say, so he had to bite the bullet and get off the car. He took out the loudspeaker, prepared for a while, and said loudly to the players, "I need some people to clear a safe area nearby for everyone to set up camp. Since you are here to help, I'll have to trouble you."

These words immediately triggered a quest, and all the players received it. With a boom, they scattered like birds and beasts and immediately got to work.

The surroundings immediately became a construction site, clearing up debris and beasts.

Coney Fury was surprised. He did not expect this group of Inhumans to give him face.

He turned around and looked at Han Xiao in the car. He understood that the Inhumans were not giving him face, but rather, they were giving face to this mysterious officer.

…

With the help of the players, a safe area was cleared in the evening. It was a stadium, which was naturally suitable for outdoor camping. The dangerous insects and beasts around were all driven away by the players.

The people of the Dark Net got Han Xiao's approval and set up small folding turrets around the stadium for automatic defense, which attracted many players to look at them curiously.

Using the vehicles as barriers to protect the tents, the players rested in the other areas. The inside of the stadium became a bustling area, with thousands of players interacting. Many of them knew each other, and some even set up stalls. It was quite a lively scene, dispelling the bleak atmosphere of the abandoned city.

The ruins that had been silent for decades were once again filled with voices.

"Great, great god!"

When Hao Tian was being led by Bear Cub, he suddenly heard someone calling him. He turned around and saw Jade Green Sky and the other core members of the Sky Territory Guild behind him, looking at him excitedly.

Hao Tian nodded, looked at the crowd, and said, "You've worked hard. Hello."

"It's what we should do." Jade Green Sky was excited. Only those who were familiar with him would call him 'Long'. Sky Territory was a guild under the Long Sky Club, and Hao Tian was the pillar of Long Sky. They were colleagues and knew each other.

The club guilds needed to provide help to the pro players because the pro players were the face of the club. Hao Tian's position was higher, and he was also the idol of his own guild.

Jade Green Sky did not hesitate to bring people to the sanctuary. One of the important reasons was that he knew Hao Tian was with Black Phantom, so he rushed over to help.

Among all the players who came to the sanctuary, Sky Territory was the only big guild. Most of the other players were casual players. Bun-hit-dog was recognized at a glance. As the most popular video host at the moment, he had a lot of fans, and they were all very passionate.

"Dog author, don't run!"

"Give me your head, I'll show you a treasure!"

"Taste the anger of the Africans!"

"You still haven't updated? I'll break your legs! "

A group of angry fans waved their weapons and chased after Bun-Hit-Dog, yelling loudly. The players at the side made way for them and watched the show with great interest. Some people even started to sell snacks and cheered loudly. All kinds of "kill him" sounds could be heard continuously, mixed with laughter.

Pork Bun did not forget to record while running away. He looked at the camera and said loudly, "This meeting went very smoothly. The fans are very passionate. As the saying goes, beating is affection, scolding is love. The more you love, the more you want to hurt him. If you don't kill each other, how can you love each other? I'm very comforted."

"Come, give me a smile." Pork Bun turned around and filmed the players who chased after him. He fully displayed his style of courting death. This was the self-cultivation of a video host. If he did not court death, how could he collect material that normal players could not see?

"Dog thief! Eat my axe! "

Whoosh!

A flying axe flew past his head.

Pork Bun was so scared that he shrank his head and ran away without looking back. The players behind him were panting heavily.

"Motherf * cker, how can he run so fast? My stamina is almost empty."

"He's with Black Phantom after all. His level is higher than ours …"

"Ahhh, bastard European!"

The players outside the tent were happy, but Mad Blade was very serious. He was facing an important choice.

After successfully advancing, Mad Blade was faced with three paths: Cannon Master, Mechanic, and Mechanical Pugilist. He was hesitant.

The Mechanic combat ability that Han Xiao showed was indeed very strong, but personally, Mad Blade was more inclined toward Mechanical Pugilist. He had a feeling that the Mechanic path was not suitable for him.

In the past, Han Xiao had also given him advice that he had potential in close combat and hinted that the Mechanical Pugilist path was more suitable for him.

This main account was going to participate in the Pro League. If he made the wrong choice, the disadvantage of starting over would be too great. Therefore, this choice was very important.

Mad Blade hesitated for a long time and finally decided to use the coin toss method.

It was said that the moment the coin was tossed, there would be an answer in one's heart.

Because the convoy camp was not allowed to enter, the players formed a market near the camp and waited for Black Phantom to come out and give them the mission.

A petite female player walked in the market while carrying an equipment bag that was twice as big as her body. She looked around curiously.

Passing through the market, Maple Moon stopped outside the camp. She took a deep breath and held the phone in her hand tightly.

"Finally LV 20 …"
